0022600088.text: Both the Toronto Raptors and the Chicago Bulls are opening their 2026-27 seasons, with the Raptors hosting. Toronto is without Brandon Ingram, who is out following Achilles surgery, while Nate Bittle is day-to-day with a foot injury and is a game-time decision. Chicago is missing Nic Claxton, who is out with a hamstring injury, and Isaac Okoro (undisclosed), Tobe Awaka (knee), and Zach Collins (toe, after surgery) are all day-to-day and game-time decisions. The Raptors won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 139-109 win in Chicago on March 18, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Toronto a 75% chance to win.
